_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: LKT-<recordNo>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

wipUnitName.description: Display value of wipUnitId, copied from u_mes_exe_wipUnit.recordNo

operationExecutionName.description: Display value of operationExecutionId, copied from u_mes_exe_operationExecution.recordNo

equipmentName.description: Display value of equipmentId, copied from u_mes_mdm_equipment.name

recipeName.description: Display value of recipeId, copied from u_mes_prd_recipe.name

testerIotDeviceId.description: Reference to u_mes_sys_iotDevice._id: tester IoT device

testerIotDeviceName.description: Display value of testerIotDeviceId, copied from u_mes_sys_iotDevice.name

operatorUserName.description: Display value of operatorUserId, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

attemptNo.description: 1 for the first attempt, higher for retests or repeats

fixtureToolName.description: Display value of fixtureToolId, copied from u_mes_mnt_tool.name

masterLeakVerifiedAt.description: Master leak verified date and time

verdict.description: Verdict of the leak test result

testedAt.description: Date and time when the record was tested

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName
